pairs.title: Permissive Path towards Lower Parrock - geograph.org.uk - 320456.jpg
pairs.why:
i think the first time i remember noticing how much i truly love music was when my aunt and uncle had flown me out to where they live in denver to take me on a ski trip for the first time ever. 

we were at breckenridge, i had brought my airpods so i could listen to music. i remember going down a slope and looking out at the continental divide on the horizon with this song playing and feeling this out of body joy that i have felt very few times in my life

pairs.title: Sildemow - ehemalige Scheune.jpg
pairs.why: this might be a crazy reach but this house looks like a bastion to me. like where u would go for an artist residency or something. this song feels very country, breath of fresh air, new beginnings. like the person who made the song had a tumultuous life and decided to take a risk and stay a month here. the song is the emotions he felt when first arriving
